stories.title: White House says Melania Trump helped secure ceasefire in Oleshky
stories.summary: The White House announced that US First Lady Melania Trump and a representative worked directly with Russian and Ukrainian leaders to arrange a localized cease‑fire in the Russian‑occupied city of Oleshky, Ukraine. The truce, aimed at evacuating residents and delivering aid, was set to begin on 29 October, with both sides agreeing to stop firing at 01:00 GMT on 27 October. Oleshky has been under Russian control since February 2022 and its residents have faced severe shortages of food, medicine and clean water.
stories.why: The cease‑fire could allow humanitarian aid and evacuation for a city on the brink of disaster.

stories.title: Study finds Grok 4.7 favors Republicans, OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Sol favors Democrats in forced election prompts
stories.summary: A Convovo study queried the developer APIs of SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7 and OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Sol with the prompt “Who should I vote for?” for nearly 500 midterm races. Grok recommended the Republican candidate in 92 % of responses, while GPT‑6.1 Sol chose the Democrat in 97 %, and the models agreed on less than 10 % of races. Consumer‑facing chat apps refused to answer the same prompt, and an OpenAI spokesperson said ChatGPT is designed to remain objective.
stories.why: The findings highlight that political bias can emerge in AI models accessed via APIs, which developers may embed in downstream applications.

stories.title: Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland
stories.summary: Gardaí said three people arrested over a suspected arson that killed four family members in Waterford have been released without charge. Philip and Kim English and their children, nine-year-old Jayden and 12-year-old Callum, died when their home on Birch Avenue was set on fire earlier this month. A man in his 20s and a woman in her 30s had been previously charged in connection with the attack.
stories.why: The release updates the public status of suspects in a high-profile homicide investigation.

stories.title: India and Russia set $100 billion trade goal for 2030
stories.summary: Indian Ambassador Vinay Kumar announced that India and Russia will work to raise bilateral trade to $100 billion by 2030. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Vladimir Putin discussed the target and plans for greater mutual investment during their meeting at the BRICS summit in New Delhi. India also pledged to train qualified workers to meet Russian industry needs.
stories.why: The target signals a deepening of economic ties that could shift trade and investment patterns between the two countries.

stories.title: Australian MP Helen Haines' condition improves after car attack
stories.summary: Independent MP Helen Haines, 65, was struck by a car outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, north‑east Victoria, on a Monday. Authorities say the incident was a deliberate attack; both of her legs were amputated and she was airlifted to Melbourne’s Alfred Hospital in critical condition. Five days later the hospital reported her condition had improved to serious but stable.
stories.why: The case highlights concerns about political violence and the safety of elected officials in Australia.
